symptom: DevBox can't reach internal services even though VPN configured in blueprint

diagnostic_steps.command: # inside devbox: pgrep -a openvpn  ; ip addr show tun0
diagnostic_steps.expected: openvpn running and tun0 has IP
AUTH_FAILED, TLS handshake fail, or 'Initialization Sequence Completed'

fix_steps.action: Provide VPN config + creds via secrets
fix_steps.command: # environment.yaml: secrets: [{name: VPN_CONFIG, target: /etc/openvpn/client.conf}]; setup: openvpn --daemon --config /etc/openvpn/client.conf

fix_steps.action: For static IP whitelisting: use Devin enterprise static IP

symptom: Setup fails behind corporate proxy: 'Could not resolve host' or proxy 407

fix_steps.action: Set proxy env in blueprint setup
fix_steps.command: # environment.yaml: setup: |  echo 'export HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy:3128\nexport HTTPS_PROXY=$HTTP_PROXY\nexport NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1' >> ~/.bashrc
# echo 'Acquire::http::Proxy "http://proxy:3128";' | sudo tee /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99proxy; git config --global http.proxy http://proxy:3128; npm config set proxy http://proxy:3128

symptom: Devin's curl/git fails 'self-signed certificate' or 'unable to get issuer'

fix_steps.action: Inject corporate CA bundle into devbox trust store
fix_steps.command: # environment.yaml: secrets: [{name: CORP_CA, target: /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corp.crt}]; setup: sudo update-ca-certificates

symptom: Devin's terminal commands return stale env / wrong working directory after long sessions

diagnostic_steps.command: # session terminal → new tab → echo $PATH; pwd

fix_steps.action: Move side-effects out of .bashrc into shell wrapper
fix_steps.command: # .bashrc should be idempotent (set PATH/aliases); long-running setup belongs in blueprint setup
